scope: Resource sanity check for 143 precincts, not a national scaling benchmark
permission_note: Read-only sysctl query initially denied by sandbox, then succeeded through the approved escalation tool. No system or environment change.
safeguard: A and D run sequentially as one four-chain rjags object each. External timeout 1200 seconds per model; no retry or automatic extension. No installation or national job.
interpretation: Storage/array arithmetic and observed machine capacity make this bounded pilot feasible to attempt. They do not establish convergence, effective precision or national scalability.
